scope: native svMultiPhysics Taylor-Hood staged validation; no production mutations
tolerance_definition: max absolute component error / max(1, max absolute exact component), for dimensionless B1/B2 fixtures; no post-hoc tolerance changes
B2_analytic_field: u=(z*(1+x), z*(2+y), z*z), wall z=0; dimensionless representation fixture, not a Navier-Stokes solution
B3_boundary_rule: midpoint fixed iff its exact corner-ID edge occurs in at least one actual WALL triangle; endpoints on WALL alone do not imply edge on WALL
B3_stop_rule: If actual original tetra 138584 has zero free TET10 velocity nodes, Stop B, no C/D/E/F
